title: Unexpected financial-system reports delayed San Francisco’s year-end close

beats.text: In fiscal 2014 City auditors identified inconsistent technology governance across departments.

visual.sub: City technology governance controls repeated in successive audits

beats.text: The finding repeated in 2015, then was marked implemented the following year.
A separate reporting problem followed the July 2017 move to PeopleSoft.

visual.kicker: A separate financial reporting problem followed a platform change

beats.text: Some financial reports did not produce the results staff expected.

visual.kicker: A separate financial reporting problem followed a platform change

beats.text: Staff spent considerable time checking those reports.

visual.kicker: A separate financial reporting problem followed a platform change

beats.text: For the 2018 close, staff created additional spreadsheets and reconciliations.
Auditors said the extra work significantly delayed the statements and the audit.
They did not state how many days were lost.
The Controller began building a library of validated reports.

visual.kicker: The following report marked the recommendation implemented

beats.text: The fiscal 2019 audit marked the recommendation implemented.
It did not measure how much staff time the changes saved.

visual.kicker: The following report marked the recommendation implemented

beats.text: A dated close calendar would show the change.
